text: # SEO and GEO audit: Brightside Dental I found 11 problems. This was a static read of all 11 files; I didn't build the site or change anything. ## Critical (blocks indexing or ranking) 1. **Wrong canonical domain.** `src/_includes/base.njk:8` points every page's canonical to `staging.brightside-dental.example`. Your real origin is `www.brightside-dental.example` (`geo.config.json:1`, `src/robots.txt:3`, `src/sitemap.xml`). Search engines and AI crawlers are told to treat the staging host as the authoritative URL. - **Fix:** use `https://www.brightside-dental.example{{ page.url }}`, ideally from a shared site-data variable. 2. **Services page is noindexed but listed in the sitemap.** `src/services.njk:5` sets `noindex: true`, yet the page is in `src/sitemap.xml:4`. This is probably a leftover. The page holds your main commercial content and is also the page `src/index.njk:9` links to. - **Fix:** remove line 5 of `services.njk`. If the noindex is intentional, remove the sitemap entry instead. 3. **Invalid JSON-LD.** `src/contact.njk:10` has a trailing comma after the `telephone` value. Parsers will reject the whole block, so the structured data is ignored. - **Fix:** remove the comma. ## High 4. **Missing meta description on the Team page.** `src/team.njk:1-4` has no `description`, so `base.njk:7` renders an empty `content=""`. - **Fix:** add a front-matter description, and guard the tag in `base.njk:7` with `{% if description %}`. 5. **Thin structured data.** The `Dentist` schema on the contact page (`contact.njk:10`) lacks `url`, `address` (PostalAddress), `openingHours`, `image`, `sameAs`, `geo` and `priceRange`. Nothing is set sitewide. - **Fix:** move a complete `Dentist` or `LocalBusiness` block, plus `WebSite` and `Organization`, into `base.njk`. Add `Person` markup for the dentists. 6. **Pages carry no concrete, verifiable content for AI answers.** - `src/team.njk:6`: "decades of experience" with no names, qualifications, GDC numbers or bios. - `src/index.njk:7`: "Trusted by thousands" is unsupported, with no reviews or evidence. - `src/services.njk:8-9`: one-word bullets, and "prices are simple and clear" with no actual prices. - **Fix:** add named practitioners with credentials, a description and price or price-range for each service, opening hours, and a short FAQ with `FAQPage` markup. ## Medium 7. **`data-nosnippet` on insurance text.** `src/contact.njk:8` hides it from snippets and AI answers, and the text is vague anyway. - **Fix:** remove the attribute if the content should be citable, or state the actual terms. 8. **No social or share metadata.** `base.njk` has no Open Graph or Twitter tags (`og:title`, `og:description`, `og:image`, `og:url`, `twitter:card`). 9. **Missing `lang` attribute.** `base.njk:2` is ``, so use ``. 10. **Thin or unused page content.** - `index.njk:8` references `/img/reception.jpg`, but no `src/img` exists and there is no passthrough copy in `.eleventy.js:1`. The image will 404. - **Fix:** add the file and a passthrough for `src/img`, and add `width` and `height` to the ``. ## Low 11. **Crawler and sitemap hygiene.** - `src/robots.txt:1-3` allows everything, which matches `geo.config.json:1`, but it names no AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, OAI-SearchBot). Add explicit `Allow` blocks if you want that stated. - `src/sitemap.xml:3-6` has no ``, and `/thanks/` is correctly excluded. The sitemap is hand-maintained, so consider generating it from collections so it can't drift from the `noindex` flags. - There is no `llms.txt`, and `.eleventy.js:1` needs a passthrough for it if you add one. - Page titles are fine. Some are short, e.g. `contact.njk:3` "Contact", so add the location or a keyword. ## Fix order 1, 2 and 3 first (each is a one-line change), then 4, then 5 and 6. Items 7 to 11 can follow in any order.
